scope: Offline recovery and per-rank artifact delivery judgment; no model execution changes

Require actual nonnegative finite prefill_token_volume and non-placeholder model/precision; schema name or model=unknown alone is not evidence. Reject declared=false and malformed metadata.
Recovery of multiple ranks requires an explicit ascend_pt path; no mtime-based implicit rank selection. Single-rank window input remains supported.
recover-profile --help reports usage without inspecting or writing a window.
boundaries: No historical artifact is rewritten or relabelled; outputs still use new append-only filenames.
Missing parsed input still fails without automatically parsing raw trace or deleting anything.
window_opstat_ok is also used by live profile delivery and slim, so invalid weight/shape metadata can no longer authorize slimming. Existing explicit-hint association behavior is otherwise unchanged.
Live capture rank selection is not changed; this patch only makes offline recovery rank selection explicit.
No L0 applicability inference or synthetic-to-measured relabelling; operator candidate remains validating/default-off.
No service start, profile collection, model smoke, model L3 or full-repository pytest; source changes do not affect model numerics.
